title: Linocut Pull
description: A linocut of a DJ, inked on the bench under a sheet of Japanese paper. Peel the sheet back by its corner: a slow pull prints rich and solid, a fast one comes out starved and speckled, and the block keeps the ghost.
intent: One printmaking act finished to the edge: the pull, where how fast your hand lifts the paper decides how much ink it takes from the block.
